title: Low-degree polynomial learner program
statement: For natural numbers $n$, $\ell$, and $m$, define a random-example learning program that draws exactly $m$ independent uniform labeled examples from the sign cube $\{\pm1\}^n$, charges the local work specified by the low-degree learner for those samples, and returns the learner's resulting hypothesis, given by a coefficient in $\mathbb{F}_2$ for each monomial of degree at most $\ell$.
